notes: Solo AI. Same rules as players, no resource cheats.

rows.behaviour: Keep metal/energy income ratio near 1:10; build extractors on free spots, energy when energy-starved, storage when overflowing
Opening: 2 extractors, 1 energy, barracks, builder, 2 extractors, energy; then scale factories with income
Go T2 when income >= 15 metal/s or enemy has T2; T3 at >= 40 metal/s
Counter enemy composition seen by scouts (ranged vs melee-heavy, siege vs defenses)
Keep one fast unit scouting enemy expansions; update threat map
Grid of enemy strength by cell, decays over time; used for attacks and defense
Attack when own army value > 1.3x estimated enemy at target; prefer weak extractors
Pull back units under 30% hp, focus fire, keep ranged behind melee, kite with ranged
Respond to raids with nearest group; build watchtowers at contested spots
Easy/Normal/Hard/Brutal scale APM, reaction delay and planner accuracy; never cheats on resources
